event: The party enters Floor 8's limestone caves; Dayo senses the water is wrong.
Dry corridor gives way to a film of water at the second junction.
Tomás scouts thirty meters ahead, reporting on the party channel.
Tomás reports a split: flooded left Compact route, unmapped new right branch.
Tomás reads thirty meters of submerged corridor before the first chamber.
Dayo sees the Compact's three-week-old route map doesn't match the floor.
Thirty percent of the planned route is fully underwater.
Solenne asks Tomás his Eagle Eye range on the submerged section.
Tomás says twenty meters on the surface, eight submerged; no ambush detection beyond.
Dayo calculates twenty-two meters of blind swimming.
Dayo runs through who in the party can handle the swim.
Dayo judges herself a strong swimmer, even in composite plate.
Dayo senses Tomás already has an alternative ready.
Dayo rates Nadia able, Vesper uncertain, Miriam probable, Solenne resentful.
Dayo starts moving to test the route with her body.
Dayo steps into the cold flooded section at the corridor split.
Dayo wades five meters in, water at her thighs.
Solenne says 'Dayo, hold' in her worried register.
Dayo chooses not to push on; she stops and turns.
A hook strikes from below the water through Dayo's left bracer gap and pulls.
The hidden creature drags Dayo sideways toward the deep water.
A second hook hits Dayo's left shoulder; a Sillfin Hunter grapples from below.
Dayo loses 158 HP, down to sixty-three percent.
Dayo, losing footing on silt, grabs the hook buried in her forearm.
Dayo fires Shield Rush backward, ripping the Hunter half out of the water.
The Sillfin Hunter is revealed: gray-green, four hooked forelimbs, a float-bladder.
The Hunter hits the corridor floor and the party closes in.
Miriam's Thorned Ground erupts and pins the Hunter; it shrieks.
Tomás, on a formation above, puts two arrows through its float-bladder.
Dayo drives her gauntlet through the Hunter's skull.
Nobody speaks for eight seconds.
Dayo stands bleeding in the shallows, her left arm impaired by four lacerations.
Dayo resolves to raise the bracer gap with Vesper later.
Solenne says flatly that Dayo's HP is at sixty-three percent.
Dayo hears Solenne's fear and can't handle being worried for.
Dayo answers 'Copy'.
Tomás drops from the formation with a dry alternative route.
Tomás's mapped high route through the upper caves appears on the overlay.
Dayo adopts the route without argument.
Dayo reflects that waiting ten seconds would have revealed the Hunter.
Dayo files her error: wrong, not catastrophic, won't repeat.
Dayo scratches a Floor 8 mark into her left bracer with her off-hand.
Nadia comes to Dayo's side: 'I've done worse.'
Nadia jokes about swimming in Lake Michigan in March.
Dayo gives a short rough laugh that jostles her shoulder.
Dayo asks 'March?'; Nadia explains a dare at seventeen.
Nadia mentions Carla's Honda Civic-sized Lake Michigan catfish.
The party climbs a narrow dry passage through the upper limestone.
Tomás leads, sweeping ahead with Eagle Eye.
The party reaches a limestone rest alcove lit by Cavelight Moths.
The moths pulse brighter as the party enters.
Dayo sits against the wall and holds still.
Vesper hands Dayo a healing potion and sets an antidote beside her.
Vesper says Sillfin toxin is mild but better treated early.
Dayo drinks the potion and regains 150 HP, then takes the antidote.
Miriam kneels beside Dayo and places her hands on her forearm.
Miriam's level 9 Mending Touch restores 142 HP; the lacerations begin to close.
Dayo watches Miriam heal forearm then shoulder, fully present.
Dayo asks if Empathic Sense picked up anything from the hooks.
Miriam dryly says being hooked from below water is extremely unpleasant.
Dayo says that tracks; Miriam's mouth twitches.
Dayo lets the healing work and does not say she is fine.
The party follows the dry route upward another two hundred meters.
Tomás stops forty meters ahead at a widening, still for six seconds.
Solenne calls Tomás's name on the party channel.
Tomás reports a larger, brighter chamber sixty meters ahead off the route.
Tomás adds he hears a sound, not monster or cave noise.
Dayo's Combat Perception maps the party's positions.
Dayo asks what kind of sound; Tomás answers 'Organized.'
The moths flash and shadows down the corridor seem to move deliberately.
Dayo touches her bracer tally marks without adding one, and waits.
